# NEW 2026-11-24 v25.0 Colonization 4.0 (oe_col4_, 0 mainline slots, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v250_colonization4.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# ZERO bare if/else in scripted_triggers (EU5 1.4.9 hard rule).

# Location scope. True when location lies in Americas or Oceania colonial frontiers.
oe_col4_is_colonial_frontier_loc = {
	OR = {
		continent = continent:america
		continent = continent:oceania
	}
}

# Country scope. Matches true Colonial Nations (colonial_nation / is_colonial_subject)
# AND overseas New World / Oceania provincial subjects (fiefdom / dominion / vassal, e.g. 1776 releases).
oe_col4_is_overseas_colonial_subject = {
	is_rebel_country = no
	OR = {
		is_subject_type = colonial_nation
		is_colonial_subject = yes
		trigger_if = {
			limit = {
				is_subject = yes
				OR = {
					is_subject_type = fiefdom
					is_subject_type = dominion
					is_subject_type = vassal
				}
				exists = capital
				exists = overlord
			}
			overlord = { exists = capital }
			capital = { oe_col4_is_colonial_frontier_loc = yes }
			NOT = { capital.continent = overlord.capital.continent }
		}
		trigger_else = { always = no }
	}
}

# Country scope. True when country has an overseas colonial subject in scope:oe_col4_region.
oe_col4_has_regional_colony = {
	trigger_if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:oe_col4_region }
		any_subject = {
			oe_col4_is_overseas_colonial_subject = yes
			exists = capital
			capital = { region ?= scope:oe_col4_region }
		}
	}
	trigger_else = { always = no }
}

# Location scope. Precious, strategic metal, or spice RGOs that Columbian Exchange must NEVER overwrite!
oe_col4_is_protected_rgo = {
	OR = {
		raw_material ?= goods:goods_gold
		raw_material ?= goods:silver
		raw_material ?= goods:gems
		raw_material ?= goods:pearls
		raw_material ?= goods:silk
		raw_material ?= goods:cloves
		raw_material ?= goods:pepper
		raw_material ?= goods:saffron
		raw_material ?= goods:ivory
		raw_material ?= goods:amber
		raw_material ?= goods:coal
		raw_material ?= goods:iron
		raw_material ?= goods:copper
		raw_material ?= goods:tin
		raw_material ?= goods:lead
		raw_material ?= goods:mercury
		raw_material ?= goods:saltpeter
		raw_material ?= goods:alum
		raw_material ?= goods:tea
		raw_material ?= goods:coffee
		raw_material ?= goods:cocoa
		raw_material ?= goods:sugar
		raw_material ?= goods:tobacco
		raw_material ?= goods:cotton
		raw_material ?= goods:potato
		raw_material ?= goods:maize
		raw_material ?= goods:horses
	}
}

# Location scope. Eligible Old World agricultural location for New World staple (potato/maize) introduction.
oe_col4_valid_ow_staple_loc = {
	NOT = { continent = continent:america }
	NOT = { oe_col4_is_protected_rgo = yes }
	population >= 2.0
	OR = {
		climate = continental
		climate = oceanic
		climate = mediterranean
		climate = subtropical
	}
}

# Location scope. Eligible Old World warm location for New World cash crops (tobacco/cocoa).
oe_col4_valid_ow_cashcrop_loc = {
	NOT = { continent = continent:america }
	NOT = { oe_col4_is_protected_rgo = yes }
	population >= 2.0
	OR = {
		climate = tropical
		climate = subtropical
		climate = mediterranean
	}
}

# Location scope. Eligible New World location for Old World horses/livestock ranching.
oe_col4_valid_nw_ranch_loc = {
	continent = continent:america
	NOT = { oe_col4_is_protected_rgo = yes }
	population >= 1.0
	OR = {
		climate = continental
		climate = oceanic
		climate = subtropical
		climate = mediterranean
		climate = hot_semi_arid
		climate = cold_semi_arid
	}
}

# Location scope. Eligible New World location for Old World sugar/coffee/wheat estates.
oe_col4_valid_nw_plantation_loc = {
	continent = continent:america
	NOT = { oe_col4_is_protected_rgo = yes }
	population >= 1.0
	OR = {
		climate = tropical
		climate = subtropical
		climate = mediterranean
		climate = oceanic
		climate = continental
	}
}

# Country scope. Eligible Old World participant in Global Columbian Exchange 2.0 (Age IV+).
oe_col4_can_import_nw_crops = {
	is_rebel_country = no
	current_age_or_later = { age = age_4_reformation }
	exists = capital
	capital = { NOT = { continent = continent:america } }
	OR = {
		any_subject = {
			oe_col4_is_overseas_colonial_subject = yes
			exists = capital
			capital = { continent = continent:america }
		}
		any_owned_location = { continent = continent:america }
		is_situation_active = situation:columbian_exchange
		AND = {
			current_year >= 1570
			has_ports = yes
			num_locations >= 12
		}
	}
	any_owned_location = {
		OR = {
			oe_col4_valid_ow_staple_loc = yes
			oe_col4_valid_ow_cashcrop_loc = yes
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Eligible New World or Colonial participant for Old World livestock/estates (Age IV+).
oe_col4_can_import_ow_livestock = {
	is_rebel_country = no
	current_age_or_later = { age = age_4_reformation }
	OR = {
		AND = { exists = capital capital = { continent = continent:america } }
		any_owned_location = { continent = continent:america }
	}
	OR = {
		oe_col4_is_overseas_colonial_subject = yes
		any_subject = { oe_col4_is_overseas_colonial_subject = yes }
		is_situation_active = situation:columbian_exchange
		current_year >= 1550
	}
	any_owned_location = {
		OR = {
			oe_col4_valid_nw_ranch_loc = yes
			oe_col4_valid_nw_plantation_loc = yes
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. True when country has overseas holdings in the same region as an owned overseas colonial subject.
# AI consolidates non-core enclaves automatically; players may also consolidate overseas New World/Oceania holdings.
oe_col4_has_consolidatable_enclaves = {
	is_rebel_country = no
	exists = capital
	any_subject = {
		oe_col4_is_overseas_colonial_subject = yes
	}
	any_owned_location = {
		is_capital = no
		NOT = { continent = root.capital.continent }
		OR = {
			NOT = { is_core_of = root }
			AND = {
				root = { is_ai = no }
				oe_col4_is_colonial_frontier_loc = yes
			}
		}
		save_temporary_scope_as = oe_col4_enclave_loc
		root = {
			any_subject = {
				oe_col4_is_overseas_colonial_subject = yes
				exists = capital
				capital.region = scope:oe_col4_enclave_loc.region
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. True when an overseas colonial subject carries a full-title Colonization 4.0 name
# (e.g. 新西班牙总督区 / 北美十三殖民地 / 扶桑西岸都护府), so country_name_construction uses $NAME$ alone
# and NEVER doubles rank words (总督区总督区 / 殖民地伯国 / 联邦伯国 / Viceroyalty of Viceroyalty).
oe_col4_has_full_title_colonial_name = {
	oe_col4_is_overseas_colonial_subject = yes
	OR = {
		has_variable = oe_col4_named
		trigger_if = {
			limit = {
				exists = overlord
				exists = capital
			}
			capital = { oe_col4_is_colonial_frontier_loc = yes }
			overlord ?= {
				OR = {
					culture = { has_culture_group = culture_group:greek_group }
					culture = { has_culture_group = culture_group:british_group }
					culture = { has_culture_group = culture_group:french_group }
					culture.language = language:spanish_language
					culture.language = language:portuguese_language
					culture = { has_culture_group = culture_group:netherlandish_group }
					culture = { has_culture_group = culture_group:german_group }
					culture = { has_culture_group = culture_group:italian_group }
					culture.language = language:east_slavic_language
					culture.language = language:scandinavian_language
					culture = { has_culture_group = culture_group:turkic_group }
					culture = { has_culture_group = culture_group:arabic_group }
					culture = { has_culture_group = culture_group:chinese_group }
					culture = { has_culture_group = culture_group:japanese_group }
				}
			}
		}
		trigger_else = { always = no }
	}
}
